title: China’s farmland needs clean water drainage | Science
description: China is transforming its agricultural landscape by building 67 million hectares of high-standard farmland and is aiming to expand this area to 90 million hectares by 2030 (1). By improving irrigation, drainage, soils, and resilience to droughts and floods, the program has become central to China’s food security and climate adaptation. However, the rapid expansion overlooks the importance of clean agricultural drainage water. Before the completion of the planned farmland, China should ensure that the fields do not increase pollution in downstream waterbodies.
